madeBy: studio art director (run 2026-09-30-offline-games), traced from the v2 raster frames - not an official ZeptoLab asset
units: px of the v2 frame canvas 525x506 (assets/characters/omnom/frames, unity/*.png), y down, x right; Om Nom faces the viewer-left
poseCanvas: action poses (unity/hang.png...) use a 640x608 canvas = these px + (64,0)
paletteNote: docs/style.md; two flat tones (body + shade), no gloss; outline = filled dark shape under the fill (variable width)
transform: bone local = T(t) * T(pivot) * R(r deg, + = clockwise on screen) * S(s) * T(-pivot); world = parent.world * local; shape points are rest-pose canvas px of the bone that owns them. Missing t/r/s = 0/0/1.
drawing: draw shapes by ascending z (zFront replaces z for parts listed in pose.front). clip = list of shape ids, intersect all (Canvas2D: clip() per path). Shapes of one merged group (z 200-310: outline pass then fill pass) overlap across joints - that is what hides the seams. hidden=true shapes are clip helpers or optional marks (eyes.joyL/R). z 500-599 = active mouth group (families.mouth). Paths: closed Catmull-Rom splines written as cubic Bezier (M ... C ... Z); in a family every slot has the same command list, so morphing = lerp of the numbers.

2.1: same structure as 2 (bones, slots, families, pose show/hide unchanged) - only shapes, pivots and pose numbers

sprout (D-56 p.4): links rebuilt for bending - every joint has a fill circle centred ON its pivot (+7 px outline circle) shared by both links, so a bend of +-30 deg per joint shows no step, gap or doubled line; pivots moved onto the stalk axis: sprout1 (278.6,110.5), sprout2 (280.8,99), sprout3 (284.8,88.5); the shade is a left strip per link with the same joint circles; body head top runs smoothly under the sprout base (no stub / hook left on the body when the sprout bends)
grip_l: hidden root = a straight tube continuing the arm into the body (was a flare along the body edge) - no flap / step at the base while arm_l swings +-20 deg

legs (D-56): paw_bl / paw_br = foot + full-width column hidden in the body at rest (was a lobe on a narrow stem); pivots moved to the hips (column tops): paw_bl (226,354), paw_br (319,353) - a leg swings under the body about its hip (also for the lab paw dangle spring); hang / fly / fly_wide refitted: leg r within +-15 deg of upright, s[1] within 0.97..1.06 (long by shape, not stretched)
body family: belly below y 300 rounded (22 px) and smoothed - no square bottom corners or wobbly lower flanks in hang / fly; outline there 5..9 px

creases: the second paw_fl.creaseBack (duplicate id, between the two front lobes) renamed paw_fl.creaseFront; poses hang / fly / fly_wide hide all four lobe creases (paw_fl.creaseBack, paw_fl.creaseFront, paw_fr.creaseMid, paw_fr.creaseRight)
2: ARMS = FRONT PAWS (user, 2026-10-01): no separate pair of arms. body > arm_l > fore_l > paw_fl and body > arm_r > fore_r > paw_fr; parts hand_l/hand_r removed. At rest the limb is straight and hidden, the lobe stands on the ground; raising the arm lifts the lobe. Lab clips: bones hand_l/hand_r -> paw_fl/paw_fr; the paw dangle springs belong to paw_bl/paw_br only (the front paws ride on the arm chain); pose.front for chew = [paw_fl, paw_fr]
foot lobes paw_fl/fr/br/bl = own closed forms with long hidden stems; body.skirt + body.skirtOutline under them; body family cut at y 432 (no shared bottom contour)
hang/fly/fly_wide/reach refitted with body s = (1,1) and paw t/r/s[1] used as is (factor 1.0): drop the lab patches hangRig/flyRig/flyWideRig
grip_l: traced grip arm for hang = continuation of the left front paw (child of arm_l; pose hang: show grip_l.*, hide arm_l/fore_l/paw_fl); mouth bone s/t fitted so the corner fangs stay inside
lids: slots upper_f/upper_rim/lower_f/lower_rim (rim = own band; was upper_o/lower_o), seam-matched edges, no extrapolated spikes
creases renamed creaseBack/creaseMid/creaseRight, clipped to body.skirtOutline (visible only while the lobes stand on the ground); body rimL/rimR removed (tore in wide2 and dangling poses)
sprout1: narrow neck pushed into the head (no foot wings / doubled base when the head moves)
pose sad: pupils = lab fix sadRig (drop sadRig); palette shade #74B320 (lab A/B; docs/style.md is updated by the producer)

back-right LEG (v2.1): foot = the right lobe + a full-width hidden column; pivot = hip (column top); hang/fly: r about +60 swings it under the body

v2: RIGHT FRONT PAW = the hand of the right arm (child of fore_r)

body.morph: neutral <-> wide <-> wide2 (driven with the mouth open amount)

eyes.space: head-local px (= canvas px at rest)
eyes.morph: neutral <-> wide <-> wide2 (same driver as body)

lids.rimNote: v2: *_rim = the dark lid edge as its own band (thickness 4.5 px in open, the v2 line in half/sad/chew, the arc in blink/chew2) drawn over *_f, so every in-between keeps a dark edge; closed fills overlap 1.6 px under the rim; both eyes meet at one height on the seam
lids.clipNote: each lid shape is clipped to eyes.white AND the half of its eye (eyes.halfL / eyes.halfR) - intersection of the listed clips
lids.morph: all members morph (open <-> half <-> blink, sad, chew, chew2); blink = open -> blink -> open, 130 ms (D-51)

mouth.space: px relative to the mouth point (anchors.mouth); draw at mouth.world * translate(origin)
mouth.rule: morph only inside a group (equal point counts); switch groups in one frame at the peak of a squash (D-51). Teeth: 4 upper (2 corner fangs + 2 inner, blunt round tips), 2 lower in wide mouths - v2 rule.

mouth.note: = omnom_frames.json anchorsLogical.mouth (centre of the wide mouth, level point om)

hat.note: centre of the hat cuff bottom (omnom_frames.json head.frames.neutral) in head-local px; the hat is a child of head

pupils.rule: pupil centre p = rest + gaze offset (head-local); clamp p into travel[eyesForm][eye] ellipse: q=(p-c)/radii, |q|>1 -> p=c+q/|q|*radii. Checked: 8 directions at the ellipse edge -> 0 px of a pupil outside its own eye (eyes.white x half). Same ellipses as omnom_frames.json pupils.*.eyes.*.travel (ajar uses the neutral form under its head transform).

l.note: wrist (top of the front paw); attach a candy here

r.note: wrist (top of the front paw); attach a candy here

grip_l.note: v2: rope point at the top of the grip fist (rest px of grip_l; world = grip_l.world * point)

posesNote: static check poses (bone offsets + forms) that reproduce the v2 frames and D-27 poses; iou = silhouette IoU with the v2 frame. Not animation clips.
